thread:
Maya: quick heads-up — Starlane agreed to do a customer highlight. want to capture a short written story + 30-min interview for a webinar clip. timeline: draft by next wed, legal sign-off by friday.
AJ: awesome. do we have a hero metric we can call out?
Sam: they shared a few numbers in the pilot deck — 65% reduction in inference cost and 2.3x query throughput. need to confirm exact phrasing with Nina.
Maya: Nina, can you confirm exact metric language? e.g. '65% lower per-token cost' vs '65% reduction in inference cost' — marketing needs the quote to be exact.
Nina (Starlane): happy to confirm. prefer "65% lower inference cost" — that's how finance tracked it. happy to sign quote.
Olivia (Design): can someone drop a high-res logo and a hero screenshot? I need a wide 1200x600 image for the blog header.
Maya: uploading assets to the doc now — link: https://docs.redwood.ai/starlane-assets (private)
OpsBot: Reminder: interview scheduling poll created — https://cal.com/redwood/starlane-30m
AJ: sample pull quote for approval: "Redwood reduced our inference bill by 65% while improving throughput 2.3x — Starlane CTO" — copy looks long. Maya, can you shorten?
Maya: draft shorter quote for legal and customer approval: "Redwood cut our inference costs 65% and doubled throughput."
Lee (Legal): quick checklist from legal: (1) get signed customer release form (2) confirm any product names / trademark usage (3) run quote text by customer, we need explicit written approval. Also check if numbers are public.
Sam: I'll attach the release template. Maya, please confirm Nina will sign.
Maya: @Nina can you sign the release here? I'll send DocuSign. Need signature by Fri EOD to keep the schedule.
Nina (Starlane): yes I can sign. please send doc.
Olivia (Design): once signed I'll mock the hero and the webinar slide. Also need a 16:9 screenshot for the webinar thumbnail.
AJ: thinking about distribution — publish short blog + 45s social clip + include as a case vignette in the webinar. Need to route an inbound lead CTA to sales post-publish. Sam, any objections?
Sam: sounds good. We'll create a dedicated routing rule: tag leads from the Starlane asset as "starlane-case" and triage to AE team.
Maya: publishing cadence: interview Mon, draft Tue-Wed, internal review Thu, legal + customer sign-off Fri, publish next Tue. Are we missing anything?
Lee (Legal): add one more step — we need a one-week lookback in case the customer requests redaction of any sensitive detail. please document versioning in the draft.
Maya: noted. I'll add a changelog section in the doc.
Olivia (Design): @Maya can you drop a template for the thumbnail? small text + logo on left, screenshot on right.
Maya: added the template to the shared doc.
AJ: for webinar script, let's pull a 3-line summary we can read aloud and a 30s Q&A with the customer. Maya, can you prep those.
Maya: will do. final items: Nina to sign release, Lee to OK quote, Olivia to deliver hero images, Sam to configure lead routing. Thanks all — ping me if timeline slips :thumbsup:
Nina (Starlane): signed the doc — DocuSign confirmation attached.
OpsBot: Deployment note: webinar registration page live for review at https://events.redwood.ai/starlane-webinar (staging)
Lee (Legal): reviewed quote text, minor wording tweak suggested. Maya, applying edit then sending to Nina for final ack.
Maya: updated. sending final quote to Nina now.
Nina (Starlane): quote approved. you have permission to publish.
Maya: excellent — locking publish date. I'll post a final checklist here when everything's live. :rocket:
